title: 第一卷 第6章 竟敢对他这样！？-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “质感真好，微软有弹性，跟活人简直一模一样！唯一的缺点就是没体温——不过这秋老虎的天，摸着倒是降暑，真凉快~”

    霖多多说着，两只手一起平摊着按在了男人的胸膛上，从左到右，从上到下，仔仔细细地感受了一遍。

    “啧啧，这胸肌，这腹肌！也不知道照着谁的身材设计的，标准的跟教科书似的！”

    她一边找电源开关，一边忍不住左捏捏、右戳戳，眼睛亮晶晶的，嘴里啧啧称奇。那模样不似在贪图美色，倒像是一个小孩发现了一块巨大的捏捏乐，玩得不亦乐乎。

    ·

    与此同时，正坐在车里往家赶的上官程，不自在地扭动了一下身体。

    “强行迁魂除了头疼，还有其他症状吗？”他皱眉问向开车的常野。

    常野摇头：“强行迁魂的不适反应就是头疼，除此之外，没听说有其他症状。尤其您这是迁回自己的本体，这种头痛也会慢慢消失的。”他从后视镜里看了上官程一眼，担忧地问，“老大，您怎么了？有什么不对劲？”

    上官程的手不由自主地抚上了自己的胸口——那里传来一阵奇怪的酥麻感，像有什么柔软的东西在按压、揉捏，一下又一下，不轻不重，却让他的皮肤起了一层细密的鸡皮疙瘩。

    他顺着那股感觉挠了挠，却并无效果。

    “没多难受，”他的声音有些发紧，“就是身上有点发痒。”

    常野思索着：“痒？让蚊虫咬了？不该的吧，我几乎是寸步不离的照顾您！一只蚊子都别想靠近的！”

    “呃嗯！”常野话还没说完，那股酥酥麻麻的痒意忽然转移了。环在腰间，向着某个不可言说的部位试探。惹得上官程漏出一声低吟。

    常野从后视镜里看到他脸颊发红，薄唇紧抿，一副隐忍的模样，慌张道：“老大，您没事吧？那俩混蛋医生是不是给您用了什么奇怪的药？您这状态……好不对劲！”

    “没有。”上官程咬牙摇头，声音沙哑得不像话，“应该不是他们的问题……是我这身体……不对劲。”

    ·

    溪山深处，霖多多方才已经把上官程上半身的每一块肌肉都查过了，依然没有找到类似“开关”的存在。

    她叹了口气，将目光移到了下半身。上官程感受到的异样就是霖多多在尝试给他褪裤。

    但机器人质量太大，她试了几次太费劲，便放弃了。最终只脱了靴子，将裤腿一层层卷了上去。

    “做工也太精细了吧……竟然还有腿毛。”

    霖多多看着面前修长的两条腿，惊讶地眨了眨眼，伸出指尖，轻轻拨过那层细密的绒毛。

    车内，上官程猛地捂住小腿。

"The texture is really good, the texture is elastic, and it looks exactly like a living person! The only drawback is that there is no body temperature - but on this autumn day, it does cool down to the touch, it's really cool~"

Lin Duoduo said, spreading his hands flat and pressing them on the man's chest, feeling it carefully from left to right, top to bottom.

“Tsk, tsk, these chest muscles, these abdominal muscles! I don’t know whose figure they were designed after, they are as standard as a textbook!”

While looking for the power switch, she couldn't help but pinch and poke her left and right, her eyes bright and her mouth full of wonder.It didn't look like he was coveting beauty, but rather like a child who had discovered a huge piece of kneading fun and was having a great time playing with it.

·

At the same time, Shangguan Cheng, who was driving home in the car, twisted his body uncomfortably.

“Besides headaches, are there any other symptoms of forced soul transfer?” He frowned and asked Chang Ye who was driving.

Changye shook his head: "The uncomfortable reaction of forced soul transfer is headache. Apart from this, I have not heard of other symptoms. Especially since you are transferring back to your own body, this headache will gradually disappear." He glanced at Shangguan Cheng in the rearview mirror and asked worriedly, "Boss, what's wrong with you? Is there anything wrong?"

Shangguan Cheng's hand involuntarily touched his chest - there was a strange tingling sensation there, as if something soft was pressing and kneading, one after another, neither light nor heavy, but it made his skin a layer of fine goosebumps.

He scratched along the feeling, but it had no effect.

"It's not too uncomfortable," his voice was a little tight, "I just feel a little itchy."

Changye thought: "Itchy? Got bitten by a mosquito? You shouldn't be. I will take care of you almost every step of the way! Don't even think about getting close to a mosquito!"

"Uh-huh!" Before Chang Ye could finish his words, the tingling sensation suddenly shifted.Wrapping it around the waist, testing towards some indescribable part.This caused Shangguan Cheng to let out a low groan.

Changye saw in the rearview mirror that his cheeks were red and his thin lips were pursed tightly, with a forbearing look, and he said in a panic: "Boss, are you okay? Did those two bastard doctors give you some strange medicine? Your state... is not right!"

"No." Shangguan Cheng gritted his teeth and shook his head, his voice hoarse, "It shouldn't be their problem...it's my body...something's wrong."

·

Deep in Xishan, Lin Duoduo had just checked every muscle in Shangguan Cheng's upper body, but still couldn't find anything similar to a "switch".

She sighed and moved her gaze to her lower body.The strange thing Shangguan Cheng felt was that Lin Duoduo was trying to take off his pants.

But the robot was too heavy and she gave up after trying a few times.Finally, he only took off his boots and rolled up his trouser legs layer by layer.

"The workmanship is too fine...it even has leg hair."

Lin Duoduo looked at the two slender legs in front of him, blinked in surprise, stretched out his fingertips, and gently brushed through the layer of fine down.

In the car, Shangguan Cheng suddenly covered his calf.
